snippet.title: Cloudlapse! - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Cloudlapse! is a pop-matching puzzle action roguelike that brings the feel of classic Premium Casual Games into the modern era by blending old-school charm with modern game design.

The story follows a group of characters known as the Seekers, chosen by the Tower and given the chance to have their deepest wishes granted.

Cloudlapse is part of the World of Eidelyn (the Daybloom Project universe) and takes place in the same saga as In a Bit of Tales.

The game is planned to enter Alpha Test Early Access in early 2027, followed by a premium Steam release in 2028. Stay tuned for more updates!

Check out the link for more information
https://daybloomproject.itch.io/cloudlapse
